provenance: Same agent has previously seen the 8-9.53s candidate; cannot claim blinded or independent testing. Raw-only sheets sampled every 0.5s across clip, dense fixed lower-pitch crops every 6 frames in 7-10s,19-22s,30-33s,44-47s. No detector overlays during point annotation. Thresholds fixed before comparing the new labels to the frozen sequence output; do not tune the production model on this audit and call it held-out performance.
window_revision_note: Extended 30-33s to 30-34s before scoring, to include receipt of the white backward pass visible in raw sheets. No threshold tuning or comparison to ball coordinates was performed to set this extension.
event_definition: Completed visible same-colour transfer to a different physical player; start is ball release, end is first controlled receipt. Dribble, tackle, deflection, ID swap and uncertain/out-of-view receipt excluded. Shot requires visual evidence of a deliberate goal attempt, not image velocity, proximity to goal or a pass toward goalkeeper. Missing positive shots cannot establish shot recall. Events outside closed review windows are not scored.
